entries.query:
All of Sasha Banks's achievements and milestones throughout her career
In your reply, I’d like you to just list the results, nothing else.
entries.answer:
- First WWE contracted signing among the "Four Horsewomen" (Charlotte Flair, Becky Lynch, Bayley, Sasha Banks) to debut on the main roster, with all four's main-roster debuts occurring the same night in 2015.[1][2]
- NXT Women's Championship, one reign (won Feb. 11, 2015 at NXT TakeOver: Rival, defeating Charlotte in a fatal four-way also involving Becky Lynch and Bayley; lost to Bayley at NXT TakeOver: Brooklyn, ending the reign at 192 days).[2][3]
- Competed in the first-ever women's Iron Man match, against Bayley at NXT TakeOver: Respect (October 2015) — the first women's match to headline an NXT TakeOver.[2]
- WWE (Raw) Women's Championship, five-time champion; first win on July 25, 2016 defeating Charlotte Flair on the first Raw following the 2016 brand draft.[3][4]
- Set the record for most Raw Women's Championship reigns (tying/topping prior records with her fourth reign in 2017 and additional reigns after).[4][5]
- Competed in the first-ever women's Hell in a Cell match.[6][7]
- Competed in the first-ever women's Royal Rumble match and first-ever women's Elimination Chamber match.[7][6]
- WWE SmackDown Women's Championship, one-time champion, won by defeating Bayley in a Hell in a Cell match on October 25, 2020, becoming "The Boss of the Cell".[3][7]
- WWE Women's Tag Team Championship, three-time champion — twice with Bayley (as "The Boss 'n' Hug Connection," first winning it Feb. 17, 2019 at Elimination Chamber, among the inaugural title holders) and once with Naomi (won in a Fatal 4-Way at WrestleMania 38, 2022).[4][6][3]
- WWE Women's Triple Crown Champion and WWE Women's Grand Slam Champion.[8]
- NXT Match of the Year honors for her Iron Man match vs. Bayley at NXT TakeOver: Brooklyn (August 22, 2015).[3]
- Left WWE in 2022; debuted in New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) on January 4, 2023 under the new ring name Mercedes Moné.[3]
- Became the only woman to win championships across the four major promotions WWE, AEW, NJPW, and CMLL.[9][2]
- CMLL World Women's Championship — won from Zeuxis at Grand Slam Mexico (June 2025); made three successful defenses before losing the title to Persephone on March 6, 2026, ending the reign at 262 days.[10][11]
- AEW TBS Championship, one-time champion — won from Willow Nightingale at Double or Nothing on May 26, 2024; made 22+ successful defenses against opponents including Kris Statlander, Skye Blue, Hikaru Shida, Britt Baker, Mina Shirakawa, and Nyla Rose; became the longest-reigning TBS Champion in title history at 584 days before losing it back to Willow Nightingale on the New Year's Eve Dynamite (Dec. 31, 2025/Jan. 1, 2026).[12][13][14][15]
- Reportedly signed one of the richest deals in women's wrestling history with AEW, said to be worth over $10 million annually.[16]
- At various points held up to nine physical championship belts simultaneously across multiple independent and international promotions, including the RevPro Undisputed British Women's Championship, Discovery Wrestling Scottish Women's Championship, EWA Women's Championship (Austria), PTW Women's Championship (Poland), BestYa Women's Championship (Italy), and the 2025 Owen Hart Foundation Championship.[14]
- As of March 2026, held eight physical championship titles including the Bodyslam Women's Championship (Denmark), WPW Women's Championship (Canada), and APAC Women's Championship (Malaysia), alongside several of the above.[10]
- Credited by wrestling media as an 8-time World Champion overall, with 15 total championships won across major promotions in her career.[8]
